selection.criterion: max NDCG, ties Recall then lower full cost; simple comparator has CT tuning cost <= controller

controller_train.scope: Controller branches include scalar CPU features/prediction and MPS serving; no separate CPU decision charge

policy_valid.scope: Controller branches include scalar CPU features/prediction and MPS serving; no separate CPU decision charge

rank_scope: Exact top100 positions; all other ranks are the outside-top100 sentinel 1000000; not valid for MRR or full-rank analysis
cost_scope: Interleaved complete B=1 branches: controller scalar CPU features/prediction + MPS serving; no separate CPU charge; history loading/network excluded
